rate_limits: Main public instance fair-use: under ~10,000 queries/day and under ~1 GB download/day. Dynamic per-client slot throttling (often a small number, e.g. Rate limit: 2 on /api/status); cool-down after each query; HTTP 429 when no slot available. Timeout/maxsize also limit long queries.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Entry wrongly treated “~10,000” as slots; official fair-use is <~10k queries/day and <~1 GB/day (https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API ; https://dev.overpass-api.de/overpass-doc/en/preface/commons.html). Slots are a separate, small dynamic per-client limit shown on /api/status (live sample Rate limit: 2); denied requests return HTTP 429.
